description: This Java class 'SelfSavingsDataValidator' provides validation methods for self-savings data and API request parameters within the Fineract project. It handles validation of retrieval requests, transaction requests, and savings application JSON data, including error handling for unsupported parameters and invalid JSON.

classes.name: SelfSavingsDataValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class that validates self-savings related API requests and JSON data, ensuring correct parameters and data integrity.

methods.name: SelfSavingsDataValidator
methods.description: Constructor that injects the FromJsonHelper dependency.

methods.name: validateRetrieveSavings
methods.description: Validates query parameters for retrieving savings, checking for unsupported parameters.

methods.name: validateRetrieveSavingsTransaction
methods.description: Validates query parameters for retrieving savings transactions.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfReqd
methods.description: Throws an exception if there are unsupported parameters in the request.

methods.name: validateTemplate
methods.description: Checks if the request is for a template and adds 'template' to unsupported params if so.

methods.name: validateSavingsApplication
methods.description: Validates JSON input for savings application, ensuring required fields are present and valid.
